description: Treet Corporation Limited is a Pakistani manufacturing company whose blade and razor manufacturing facilities have been ISO 9001:2015 certified since 1997. The company describes itself as more than a manufacturer, presenting its products as a symbol of innovation, quality and trust in the market it serves.
sourceNote: Company website (treetcorp.com: who-we-are, home contact block), read 2026-10-17. The site publishes no registered office address; the number given is the company secretariat line.
